## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`, the provenance standard, and the security policy.
- [ ] Every raw artifact is byte-preserved, has no inserted front matter, and matches its recorded SHA-256 checksum and byte count.
- [ ] Model name, exact identifier, interface, mode, tools, date, context, and edit status are recorded when available; missing facts are `unknown`.
- [ ] Model claims and self-reports are labeled as hypotheses or operational proposals rather than facts.
- [ ] Reviews, testing, reproduction, and outcome are represented as separate evidence dimensions.
- [ ] Prompt, parent, content, review, case, and result paths resolve.
- [ ] I included negative, mixed, failed, and inconclusive results where applicable.
- [ ] I have permission to publish every included item and stated artifact-level licensing accurately.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, personal data, confidential conversations, private repository material, or proprietary content without permission.
- [ ] I ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 scripts/validate_repository.py`.
